title: Output schema for the Polymarket Multi-Outcome Arbitrage Scanner
description: Two outputs: a dataset of confidence-scored basket arbitrage opportunities and a key-value record summarizing the scan.

opportunities.title: Arbitrage opportunities
opportunities.description: Dataset of detected basket arbitrage opportunities. Each item is one Polymarket event with leg-by-leg basket composition, fee-adjusted return, per-leg fillability, signal score, and event classification (winner_take_all or top_k).

summary.title: Scan summary
summary.description: Single key-value record summarizing the scan: timestamp, total events scanned, eligible event count, pure arb count, EV+ count, average net return, and best opportunity ID.
